meta.title: WSL Workspaces
meta.description: Choose a WSL distribution and Linux directory, then open its independent Harness backend in your browser.

setupNotice: Check the selected WSL runtime before preparing a workspace. Downloads start only after you explicitly consent and click Initialize. Windows folders need no WSL setup.
title: Choose workspace environment
notice: WSL workspaces open in a separate browser tab with an independent Linux backend. Existing Windows sessions are not moved. Configure your model in that backend if needed.
noDistros: No WSL distributions found. Install a distribution, then retry.
truncated: Only part of this directory is shown. Enter an exact path to continue.
ready: Workspace ready. Open the authenticated link below in your browser.
invalidUrl: The backend returned an unsafe URL. Only loopback HTTP(S) links are accepted.
invalidPath: Enter an absolute Linux directory beginning with /.
busy: The workspace is being adopted. Please wait.
stopNotice: Closing this dialog cancels the request, but does not stop a backend already started.
runtimeUnknown: Check runtime before preparing this workspace.
setupConsent: I agree to download pinned Node.js 24.11.0 and Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 into this distribution’s Linux user directory. No sudo is used and system Node.js is not changed.
setupFailed: Initialization failed. Review the log and retry after fixing the cause.
setupTimeout: Stopped checking after 10 minutes. Initialization may still be running; check initialization status to resume.
setupDetached: Closing this dialog or switching environments stops monitoring, not an initialization already started.
setupConsentRequired: Select the consent checkbox before initializing.
setupInvalid: The backend returned an invalid initialization status.
